title: When Post-Sale Interest Stops on a Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Deficiency
content:
On a Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Installment Sale Contract whose repossessed vehicle has been sold, interest after the sale date runs to an end that follows how the vehicle came back and how long ago it was sold.

| How the vehicle came back, and when it was sold | Interest after the sale date |
|---|---|
| Voluntary surrender | no interest runs after the sale date |
| Involuntary recovery sold at least 60 days (the non-accrual period) before the quote date | runs for the 60 days after the sale date only |
| Involuntary recovery sold fewer than 60 days before the quote date | runs from the day after the sale date through the good-through date |

The days are counted in calendar days from the sale date recorded on the contract to the quote date.

### Boundary (hypothetical involuntary recovery)

- Sold 59 days before the quote date: interest after the sale runs through the good-through date.
- Sold 60 days before the quote date: interest after the sale runs for 60 days, ending on the 60th day after the sale date, whatever the good-through date.
- Sold 200 days before the quote date: still 60 days after the sale, no more.

### Input - judgement - output

Input: the recovery type on the contract, the sale date, the quote date. Judgement: voluntary surrender, or involuntary with a sale at least 60 days old, or otherwise. Output: no post-sale days, 60 post-sale days, or the post-sale days through the good-through date.
